summary: John Marshall Bancorp (JMSB) filed an 8-K reporting a September 7, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Eagle Financial Services (EFSI) in an all-stock, two-step reverse triangular merger plus a simultaneous bank merger of Bank of Clarke into John Marshall Bank. Each EFSI share converts into 2.00 JMSB shares; EFSI restricted stock fully vests at target with cash or stock election. Both boards unanimously approved; no price, premium or break fee disclosed. Post-close ownership, regulatory clocks and any dissent remain watch items.
